resources.string: Convert local video and audio files
Convert local video and audio files with format, codec, bitrate, resolution, FPS, quality, trim, remux, metadata, subtitle and audio controls. Batch conversion and presets are included.
Convert ZIP and CBZ manga archives
Convert ZIP to CBZ, CBZ to ZIP, ZIP to PDF, or CBZ to PDF with natural page sorting, junk-file cleanup, optional ComicInfo metadata and batch conversion.
Media Converter and Manga Converter keep independent output folders. Custom folders are remembered until you reset them.
